rationale: The assistant correctly identified moisture after cleaning as the likely cause and gave safe steps: isolate, dry, reseat caps, with a gas-smell emergency note. It used the customer's follow-up (unplugged, dried, no gas smell, cap reseated) to confirm it is fine to reconnect, with a sensible retest plan and conditional escalation to a gas engineer. No parts were recommended and nothing was invented. The only minor weakness is that it did not ask up front whether water got in, though it inferred this reasonably from the cleaning context.
